subject: FW: 2009 Fountaine Pajot Salina 48 MAC LERIC – technical information and supporting documentation
availability: Available; seller indicates room for reasonable price discussion
facts: A detailed seller-side package arrived: forensic maintenance/refit register, supporting documents and major-maintenance history. It documents a complete 2025 Z-Spars mast and standing-rigging package, 2024 Incidences sails, about 2,300W solar, Victron charging/inverter, Onan 9.5kVA generator and Aquabase 105 L/h watermaker. Owner says the old mast foot developed damage attributed to its design, prompting full mast replacement with no associated bulkhead/chainplate structural repair reported. Twin Volvo D2-55s are about 4,700h and MS130 saildrive diaphragm history cannot be substantiated since at least 2017. There is no recent full condition/moisture survey; A/C seawater pump is absent; bank is 720Ah AGM; watermaker lacks documented major service/membrane date. Seller says no known grounding/collision/storm/insurance claim/osmosis/wet core/delamination or persistent leaks and indicates some price flexibility for a straightforward timely sale.
triage: Documentation quality is unusually strong and keeps MAC LERIC in the serious group, but 4,700-hour engines are now the main decision-driving mechanical risk. Saildrive diaphragm age and lack of a recent survey remain material secondary issues.
next_action: Follow-up sent asking specifically for evidence of major 4,000-hour engine service, top-end/injector/heat-exchanger work, compression testing, oil analysis or overhaul/rebuild. No offer or travel discussion initiated.
